summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file math_init.js that begins with '// @bun @bun-cjs' and is a heavily obfuscated string-array/index dispatcher (identifiers like MmgoCP, etDiOOB, JqTtnbZ). math_init.js is not referenced by any TypeScript source in src/ or dist/ and has no relation to the advertised React IoC/dependency-injection functionality; it contains '.aws' string fragments among the obfuscated content. Executing the payload under a downloaded Bun runtime bypasses Node-based static inspection. Package metadata advertises ServiceTitan's uikit library (homepage docs.st.dev, repo github.com/servicetitan/uikit) but the upstream source tree does not contain setup.mjs or math_init.js, indicating impersonation of the legitimate publisher. The install-time invocation runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
